props.heading: SHOP BY OCCASION

props.body: Tradition, cut for today. Premium handloom and cotton Panjabis for the discerning man.

THE MODERN
PANJABI

props.subhead: Handloom, cotton, silk — for every occasion.

props.heading: EVERYDAY HERITAGE
props.subhead: Cotton sarees, handloom staples and everyday ethnic pieces.
props.subhead_bn: কটন শাড়ি, হাতে বোনা এবং দৈনন্দিন জাতিগত পোশাক।

props.body: Bride. Groom. Bridesmaids. Wedding guests. Gifts. Elegant ivory, muted rose and deep green — for the moments that matter.
props.body_bn: বধূ, বর, সাক্ষী — বিশেষ মুহূর্তের জন্য।
props.heading:
THE WEDDING
EDIT
FROM THE LOOM
props.subhead: Jamdani, Tangail Taant, Rajshahi Silk and Nakshi Kantha — timeless weaves, each with a story.
props.subhead_bn: জামদানি, টাঙ্গাইল তাঁত, রাজশাহী সিল্ক ও নকশি কাঁথা।

props.heading: COMPLETE THE LOOK
props.subhead: Jhumka, necklaces, bangles and heritage accessories.
props.subhead_bn: ঝুমকা, নেকলেস, চুড়ি ও ঐতিহ্যবাহী গহনা।

props.body: In Tangail, Sonargaon and across Bangladesh, generations of artisans carry techniques that cannot be mass-produced.
props.body_bn: টাঙ্গাইল, সোনারগাঁয়ে প্রজন্মের পর প্রজন্ম তাঁতিরা সংরক্ষণ করছেন যে কৌশল।

Worn for Years.

ধীরে তৈরি।
বছরের পর বছর পরা।

testimonials.author: Nusrat Rahman
testimonials.quote: The Jamdani saree I received was breathtaking. The weave is so intricate — I've never seen anything like it in any store.

testimonials.author: Priya Chakraborty
testimonials.quote: My husband's Panjabi arrived beautifully packaged. The handloom quality is exceptional — exactly the kind of craftsmanship you can't find elsewhere.

testimonials.author: Tasnim Ahmed
testimonials.quote: Ordered for Eid and it arrived on time with care. The cotton saree feels amazing to wear — light, breathable and strikingly beautiful.

testimonials.author: Farhan Islam
